title: Active Frontend Engineering Roles in India

researchPlan.objective: Identify and extract current frontend engineering job openings at Indian software companies from public career portals and applicant tracking systems.
researchPlan.title: Active Frontend Engineering Roles in India

outputFields.name: company_name
outputFields.description: The name of the hiring company
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for headers or company branding on the career page

outputFields.name: job_title
outputFields.description: The specific title of the frontend role
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for H1 tags or job listing titles

outputFields.name: location
outputFields.description: The office location or remote status
outputFields.validationHint: Must be in India or specified as Remote
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for location metadata or job description text

outputFields.name: application_link
outputFields.description: Direct URL to the job application page
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid, reachable URL
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for 'Apply' or 'Apply Now' button href attributes

outputFields.name: source
outputFields.description: The platform or website where the job was found
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid domain name
outputFields.extractionHint: Extract the base domain of the current page

researchPlan.sourceStrategy: Prioritize open Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and official company career pages to ensure direct, non-gated access to job listings.

validationRules.rule: Must be a functional URL leading to an application form
Must be a recognized software company entity
